daily_summary.html:
Domestic Politics

The DPR has introduced "One Data Indonesia" initiative, aimed at unifying data across government institutions. Separately, DPR Speaker emphasized that youth must be heard and given space for progress in national development.

  • Former President Jokowi is scheduled to testify as a witness in the trial of Roy Suryo next week.
  • Silmy Karim will undergo his first trial hearing today on charges of extorting foreign nationals.
  • The Coordinating Ministry for Legal, Human Rights, Immigration, and Corrections Affairs marked its second anniversary with the theme "Synergy for Justice, Dignified Indonesia."

Foreign Policy & Defence

Indonesia's Ambassador to Kazakhstan revealed that President Prabowo is planned to visit Kazakhstan in 2027. The Foreign Ministry stated that enhanced bilateral interaction could accelerate the Indonesia-Kazakhstan partnership.

  • Indonesia called for calm and joint effort following Singapore's claim regarding internet connectivity issues, with Foreign Minister Vivian Balakrishnan noting that the haze problem has persisted for three decades and requires a solution.
  • BPKH and Bank Muamalat visited the Indonesian diaspora in Malaysia to promote the youth pilgrimage program.
  • The PSSI confirmed its support for Gianni Infantino to continue leading FIFA.
  • Papua province is exploring rice exports to neighboring Papua New Guinea.

Other

The KPK has issued an investigation order in an expanded case involving Customs and Excise related to PT Djarum's excise duties, with the Kudus Customs office searched but no employees detained. Bulog has suspended six employees and formed a special task force following allegations of misuse of SPHP rice.

  • Indonesia is preparing regulations for an international financial center, while state holding company Danantara suggested that fintech can be an asset for Indonesian banks' expansion in Asia.
  • Minister Bahlil revealed the broad powers of the BUK (Upstream Oil and Gas Regulatory Body) that will be established as the Oil and Gas Bill nears completion, while MedcoEnergi and KKKS partners signed three agreements to secure domestic gas supply.
  • Bank Indonesia is working to strengthen food security and control inflation in the Sulawesi-Maluku-Papua region.
  • The government is accelerating rehabilitation and reconstruction of infrastructure and MSME facilities following disasters in Sumatra.
  • BNPB urged forest and land fire prevention down to the village level, while firefighters are racing to protect orangutan habitat as fires burn in Tanjung Puting National Park.
